extracted.name: Buttermilk Coleslaw
extracted.description: This creamy buttermilk coleslaw, made with mayonnaise, sugar, celery seed, and packaged slaw mix, is a simple side dish to serve at your next barbecue.
instruction_lines: Stir together mayonnaise, buttermilk, sugar, celery seed, and black pepper in a large bowl until well combined. Fold in coleslaw mix until evenly coated. Refrigerate before serving, at least 2 hours.
